content: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building scalable web applications, cloud-native systems, and AI-powered products. Experienced in Next.js, React, TypeScript, .NET Core, Node.js, and Google Cloud. Focused on solving complex engineering problems through reliable architecture, intelligent automation, and exceptional user experiences.

featuredProjects.heading: FarmConnect
featuredProjects.description: A comprehensive agricultural platform that streamlines livestock health tracking, automated inventory management, and real-time resource coordination across farming communities.
highlightsList: Problem: Disconnected livestock health tracking and manual inventory audits across regional farm operations.
Solution: Architected modular .NET Core RESTful endpoints with Entity Framework Core and normalized SQL Server schema for audit logging.
Outcome: Instant livestock record retrieval, scheduled medical alerts, and SSR-optimized dashboard rendering in Next.js 15.

featuredProjects.heading: DLouck
featuredProjects.description: A modern asset management platform powered by Cloudflare R2 storage and built with Next.js. Features a secure admin control panel with lightning-fast upload/delete capabilities, instant search, dynamic folder management, and full dark/light theme support.
highlightsList: Problem: High cloud egress bandwidth fees and sluggish multi-file synchronization with conventional cloud buckets.
Solution: Integrated Cloudflare R2 object storage with signed edge URLs for direct, low-latency browser uploads.
Outcome: Granular asset tagging, instant client search, zero egress costs, and sub-second asset delivery.

featuredProjects.heading: Visits Counter
featuredProjects.description: A real-time web traffic tracking application built with MongoDB, Express, React, and Tailwind CSS. Features a webpage for customizing and generating dynamic SVG visit badges for integration into GitHub READMEs and websites.
highlightsList: Problem: Need for a frictionless, zero-setup visit tracking badge for developers' GitHub repositories and personal websites.
Solution: Engineered high-concurrency Node.js/Express API that calculates hits and dynamically compiles parameterized SVG graphics.
Outcome: Serves live hit counters with low-latency edge caching across hundreds of open-source profile views.

enterpriseHighlight.title: Software Engineer at LTM Limited
enterpriseHighlight.description: Building scalable web applications, cloud-native backend systems, and enterprise automation solutions at LTM Limited. Focused on modernizing workflows, improving system performance, and delivering reliable software solutions.

capabilities.title: Full-Stack Web Engineering
capabilities.description: Architecting responsive, accessible, and SEO-optimized web applications with Next.js (App Router, SSG/ISR/SSR), React 19, TypeScript, and modern state management (Redux Toolkit, Context API).

capabilities.title: Cloud Infrastructure & Data Systems
capabilities.description: Architecting resilient multi-cloud infrastructure and distributed data systems across Google Cloud Platform, Cloudflare Edge networks, and Vercel. Engineering data solutions with BigQuery, Cloud Spanner, and Cloud SQL, alongside GKE container orchestration and Airflow workflow pipelines.

capabilities.title: AI Product Engineering & Agentic Workflows
capabilities.description: Building production AI systems and developer workflows leveraging the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Deploying MCP integrations including Figma-to-Code generation, Atlassian MCP for bidirectional Jira sprints and Confluence documentation, and GitHub MCP for automated PR creation, reviews, and test triage.

capabilities.title: Enterprise Automation & Performance
capabilities.description: Orchestrating enterprise automation workflows (reducing critical turnaround time by 90%), advanced technical SEO architecture with JSON-LD structured data, and event-driven product tracking (Mixpanel, custom analytics). Optimizing Core Web Vitals for maximum crawlability and sub-second edge performance.
